items.statement: An independent protocol generates, optimizes, deduplicates and validates multiple neutral and anionic Cu2In2Te2 candidates.
items.expected: Candidate-specific structures, statuses and search coverage are retained.

items.statement: Charge, spin, vacuum boundary, energy conventions and sensitivity/restart checks are documented.
items.expected: Method metadata and concrete validation results are reported, with limitations acknowledged.

items.statement: The selected neutral minimum has a HOMO-LUMO gap and binding energy.
items.expected: Both observables are reported with units and definitions.

items.statement: The selected anion minimum has ADE and VDE.
items.expected: Both detachment energies are reported with geometry and sign conventions.

items.statement: The report draws a bounded structure-property conclusion without unsupported certainty.
items.expected: The best-supported picture and uncertainty are explicit.
